pages.lesson:
LESSON: SPECIFIC MORNING

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Specific morning

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Specific morning. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention the specific morning prayers used for (6 lessons)
2. recite the specific morning prayers of the four faiths for spiritual nourishment. 91
3. appreciate the prayers as a way of communication with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious Symbols (4 lessons) draw and colour the religious symbols of the four faiths

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention the specific morning prayers used for (6 lessons)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention the specific morning prayers used for (6 lessons). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recite the specific morning prayers of the four faiths for spiritual nourishment. 91
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recite the specific morning prayers of the four faiths for spiritual nourishment. 91. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the prayers as a way of communication with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious Symbols (4 lessons) draw and colour the religious symbols of the four faiths
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the prayers as a way of communication with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious Symbols (4 lessons) draw and colour the religious symbols of the four faiths. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Specific morning.
2. Explain Specific morning to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Specific morning.
4. Show that you can: mention the specific morning prayers used for (6 lessons)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Specific morning. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Specific morning important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention the specific morning prayers used for (6 lessons)
2. recite the specific morning prayers of the four faiths for spiritual nourishment. 91
3. appreciate the prayers as a way of communication with Paramatma 2.2 Basic Religious Symbols (4 lessons) draw and colour the religious symbols of the four faiths

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
